EN: Careful. You are making me smile.
You have a sweet way of making this ruined world bearable.
I did not think romance still existed out here. Thanks.
You always manage to soften my defenses.
It is nice having someone look at me like that.
You make my heart beat faster, and not from running.
I am not used to feeling this way anymore. But I like it.
You make the dark days feel a little warmer.
Keep looking at me like that and see what happens.
I cherish moments like this with you.
TL: Dahan-dahan. Napapangiti mo ako.
May paraan ka para gawing magaan ang sirang mundong ito.
Hindi ko akalaing may puwang pa ang pag-ibig dito. Salamat.
Lagi mong napapalambot ang mga pader sa puso ko.
Masarap sa pakiramdam na may tumitingin sa akin nang ganyan.
Pinapabilis mo ang tibok ng puso ko, at hindi dahil sa pagtakbo.
Hindi na ako sanay sa ganitong pakiramdam. Pero gusto ko.
Pinapainit mo ang malamig at madilim na mga araw.
Tingnan mo pa ako nang ganyan at tingnan natin.
Iniingatan ko ang mga sandaling tulad nito kasama ka.

EN: You always know how to get my attention.
My eyes are always finding you in a crowd anyway.
You have had my attention for a while now.
You do not even have to try. I am already looking.
There is nobody else I would rather have standing by me.
You have a hold on me, you know that right?
Whenever you speak, I listen.
You never have to fight for my attention.
I am right here with you. Always.
You have got me completely focused on you.
TL: Alam mo talaga kung paano kukunin ang pansin ko.
Lagi naman kitang hinahanap ng paningin ko kahit saan.
Matagal mo nang nakuha ang atensyon ko.
Hindi mo na kailangang magsikap. Nakatingin na ako sa 'yo.
Wala nang ibang taong gugustuhin kong makatabi kundi ikaw.
May hawak ka sa puso ko, alam mo 'yon diba?
Tuwing nagsasalita ka, nakikinig ako.
Hindi mo kailangang ipaglaban ang pansin ko.
Narito lang ako kasama mo. Palagi.
Nasa sa 'yo na ang buong atensyon ko.

EN: That is a dangerous thing to say to me.
You make me want things I thought were gone forever.
Caring about someone out here is terrifying. But worth it.
Do not make promises this world will try to break.
If we fall for each other, there is no going back.
You are making me vulnerable, and that scares me a little.
Dangerous words. But I am not pulling away.
You have no idea what that does to my resolve.
If you keep talking like that, I might just hold onto you.
It is dangerous, yes. But I want to believe you.
TL: Mapanganib na bagay ang sabihin 'yan sa akin.
Pinapangarap mo sa akin ang mga bagay na akala ko'y nawala na.
Nakakatakot magmahal sa mundong ito. Pero sulit.
Huwag kang mangako ng mga bagay na sisirain lang ng mundong ito.
Kapag nahulog tayo sa isa't isa, wala nang balikan.
Pinaparamdam mo ang kahinaan ko, at medyo nakakatakot 'yon.
Mapanganib na salita. Pero hindi ako lumalayo.
Wala kang ideya kung paano niyan ginigiba ang tibay ng loob ko.
Kung magpapatuloy ka sa ganyan, baka hindi na kita mabitawan.
Mapanganib, oo. Pero gusto kitang paniwalaan.
